post.caption:
Base 10 is anatomy, not mathematics. Twelve divides evenly by 2, 3, 4 and 6 while ten only manages 2 and 5. The Babylonians used base 60, which is why you still get 60 seconds, 60 minutes and 360 degrees. Base 12 survives in dozens, inches and the 24-hour day, and base 20 survives in the number words of several languages. We did not choose the most convenient base. We chose the one on our hands.
